articles.title: Mastercard secures New York BitLicense to support stablecoin and digital payment infrastructure
articles.snippet: The payments giant said the approval supports its push into stablecoins and blockchain-based settlement infrastructure.

articles.title: Mastercard secures New York BitLicense for crypto operations
articles.snippet: The payments giant can now legally conduct digital asset business activity in New York as it deepens its focus on blockchain-based settlement systems.

articles.title: Prediction markets enter the derivatives era: XBIT DEX opens whitelist for prediction leverage, launching a 35,000 USDC campaign
articles.snippet: XBIT DEX takes the lead in introducing leverage to on-chain prediction markets, prioritizing the 2026 FIFA World Cup for its initial category. The whitelist application is now live.

articles.title: Bitcoin price threatens $75K loss as US-Iran peace progress sparks new stocks records
articles.snippet: Bitcoin disappointed bulls by dropping below $75,000 on Iran peace deal reports while US stocks hit new all-time highs and oil saw one-month lows on Hormuz hopes.

articles.title: StakeDAO exploit creates 5.4 trillion vsdCRV but nets only $91K
articles.snippet: PeckShield said the attacker bridged 43.7 ETH to Ethereum after minting trillions of vsdCRV, while EmberCN said most of the remaining tokens had insufficient liquidity to sell.
